description: chain_walk allocates a fixed [0u8; 8192] stack buffer and calls encode_to_slice (line 719-722). Certificates with large extensions (e.g. embedded CRL distribution points, large SAN lists, policy OID sequences) can exceed 8192 bytes. When that happens, encode_to_slice returns a DER error which is mapped to Error::Der — the caller has no way to distinguish 'buffer too small' from 'malformed certificate'. No test covers this path. The buffer size should be documented with a rationale, the error should be a distinct variant (e.g. CertTooLarge), and a test with a >8192-byte TBS should be added.
title: 8192-byte stack TBS buffer silently returns DER error on large certs
